subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should fallback diagnostics be canonicalized under openclaw models status --probe --all, exposed as /models test-fallback, or offered through both surfaces using one shared probe engine?
rationale: Current main has an established CLI probe surface, while this issue requests a narrower chat command and the overlapping open issue/PR do not settle whether ordered fallback execution or per-model reachability is the intended public contract.

options.title: Canonical CLI probe
options.body: Extend the existing models status probe to cover ordered fallback candidates, then consider a thin slash wrapper only after the shared behavior ships.

options.title: Dedicated slash command
options.body: Keep this issue distinct and implement /models test-fallback as the primary operator surface despite overlap with the existing CLI probe.

options.title: Separate diagnostics
options.body: Treat per-model health and ordered fallback-chain execution as independent commands with explicitly different contracts and documentation.

recommendation.title: Canonical CLI probe
recommendation.body: Extend the existing models status probe to cover ordered fallback candidates, then consider a thin slash wrapper only after the shared behavior ships.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to the original probe implementation and the prior item-specific product review.
